- Frankfurt/Main

Nationals of the following countries do not have the transit privilege and therefore require an airport transit visa (category A) for transit at a German airport:

Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Ghana, Iran, Iraq, Jordan*, Lebanon, Mali, Nigeria, Pakistan, Somalia, South Sudan, Sri Lanka, Sudan, Syria, Turkey*

conditions_exemptions: Ordinary passport; non-Schengen arrival and onward destination outside Schengen; remain within the international transit area. Nationality is absent from both the EU common ATV list and the country-specific additional ATV list. No airport transit visa is required for this airside scenario. Entering Schengen, an airport change or a domestic/Schengen connection requires separate entry eligibility.
current_conditions_exemptions: The United Kingdom is absent from both the common list and the Dutch additional list. No airport transit visa is required for an ordinary British citizen passport connecting at Schiphol between non-Schengen flights without leaving the international transit area. A connection requiring Schengen entry is assessed separately.
electronic_authorisation_notes: No electronic travel authorisation applies without Schengen entry.
exemption_notes: No document-based exemption is needed for this airside connection.

conditions_exemptions: Remain airside at the same airport; no UK border crossing or airport change. Travel to/from the Common Travel Area is outside this airside rule. DATV normally required. Exemptions include valid entry visas for Australia, Canada, New Zealand or USA; certain return journeys within six months of entry to those countries; qualifying permanent residence permits from those countries; common-format EEA/Swiss residence permits or category D visas; qualifying Irish BC/BC BIVS visas; specified Schengen ADS journeys. Document-format and issue-date restrictions apply, including verification of other countries’ electronic documents. Airside TWOV requires arrival/departure by air, confirmed same-day onward departure from the same airport, and destination documents. Existing valid UK Visitor/Marriage Visitor visa, ETA, EU Settlement Scheme family permit or Home Office travel document also removes the DATV requirement. See official pages for exact documentary criteria. Sample is an ordinary passport: diplomatic, service or official passport exceptions are outside this baseline.
current_conditions_exemptions: DATV required unless exempt. Airside TWOV: arrive and depart by air, confirmed same-day Heathrow onward flight, destination documents; excludes Common Travel Area routes. Visa exceptions below. Valid permanent residence: Australia/New Zealand; Canada issued after 28 June 2002; US issued after 21 April 1998, or arrival-stamped immigrant visa (no wet-ink/ADIT), expired I-551 with valid I-797 extension, or Form 155A/155B attached to a sealed brown envelope. Valid common-format EEA/Swiss residence permits, UK Standard/Marriage Visitor visas, ETA, EUSS family permit or Home Office travel document also qualify.
electronic_authorisation_notes: No ETA required without UK border control. Foreign e-visas or e-residence permits qualify only if the airline can verify them with the issuer.

conditions_exemptions: Incheon Airport international airside connection without Korean immigration clearance. Korean embassy C-3-10 guidance explicitly permits all nationalities other than ordinary passports of Egypt, Sudan, Syria and Yemen to transit without a visa if they will not clear immigration at Incheon. The separate 30-day Tourist/Transit B-2 entry scheme and its excluded-country list do not govern this airside result. No numeric airside layover maximum is stated on the cited C-3-10 page.
current_conditions_exemptions: Ordinary U.S. passport holders may connect internationally at Seoul Incheon without a visa if they do not clear Korean immigration. The separate 30-day B-2 transit-entry scheme does not govern this connection.
electronic_authorisation_notes: No K-ETA applies to this connection without immigration clearance.
evidence_excerpt: All other nationalities (excluding the aforementioned countries) who will NOT clear through immigration at Incheon Airport may transit without visa.
exemption_notes: The airside rule does not require a foreign visa or residence permit.
